description: This file defines the ExternalMessage interface, which serves as a wrapper for headers and payloads exchanged with external AMQP sources or targets in the system. It includes constants for standard headers, methods for retrieving and manipulating message headers, payloads, and associated metadata, and defines an enum for payload types.

classes.name: ExternalMessage
classes.description: An interface representing messages to and from external AMQP sources/targets, encapsulating headers, payloads, and associated metadata.

methods.name: findContentType
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the Content-Type header value if present.

methods.name: findHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the specified header key, case-sensitive.

methods.name: findHeaderIgnoreCase
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the specified header key, case-insensitive.

methods.name: isTextMessage
methods.description: Indicates if the message payload is textual.

methods.name: isBytesMessage
methods.description: Indicates if the message payload is binary bytes.

methods.name: getTextPayload
methods.description: Returns the text payload if available.

methods.name: getBytePayload
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer payload if available.

methods.name: getPayloadType
methods.description: Returns the PayloadType enum indicating the payload format.

methods.name: isResponse
methods.description: Indicates if the message is a response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Indicates if the message signifies an error.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the AuthorizationContext associated with the message, if any.

methods.name: getTopicPath
methods.description: Returns the TopicPath assigned to this message, if any.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Provides enforcement data for message filtering, if applicable.

methods.name: getHeaderMapping
methods.description: Returns header mapping configuration, if available.

methods.name: getPayloadMapping
methods.description: Returns payload mapping configuration, if available.

methods.name: getSourceAddress
methods.description: Optional source address where the message was received.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Optional source object representing message origin.

methods.name: getInternalHeaders
methods.description: Returns Ditto headers related to the message creation context.
